in_marathi.name: विजय
in_marathi.long_meaning: विजय हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name विजय (Vijay) is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘विजय' (Vijaya) which means ‘Victory’. In Hindu mythology, विजय is the name of various gods and heroes who have achieved victory over their adversaries.
